title: Why Do Our Spiritual Practices Leave Us Empty? (1991-12-06)
description:
Tired of spiritual rituals that leave you feeling empty? Discover the ancient method to actually feel divine energy on your own nervous system.

This public program bridges ancient yogic knowledge with modern seeking, explaining why true spirituality must be experienced on the central nervous system. The talk explores the history of Kundalini awakening and culminates in a practical, guided self-realization meditation session.

Key Topics:
• 💭 Why intellectual reading and mechanical rituals fail to provide true spiritual connection, and how to go beyond mental concepts
• 📜 The hidden history of Kundalini awakening, from the Nath Panthis to Gyaneshwara, and why this ancient knowledge was kept secret
• ⚡ Understanding Kundalini as your pure, completely safe motherly energy that effortlessly grants inner self-mastery and deep joy
• 🌟 Achieving collective consciousness: how to tangibly feel the state of your subtle centers (chakras) on your own fingertips
• 🧘‍♀️ Guided self-realization experience - follow along to feel the awakening of your Kundalini and cool vibrations on your hands

“And unless and until we are connected with that power we cannot know the ultimate reality, because the spirit within us is not in our attention.”
— Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi

Common Questions About Spiritual Awakening:
• How to tell the difference between a true and false guru?
• Is kundalini awakening dangerous or safe to experience?
• How to feel your chakras and energy on your fingertips?

Did you feel the cool breeze on your fingertips or top of your head during the guided meditation? Share your first realization experience!
